title: Coast Guard Assists Stranded Kayakers
description:
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Station Savannah, Ga., rescued a kayaker who became stranded in a muddy marsh near Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, after the tide went out Friday, May 16, 2014. The helicopter crew hoisted the man, who had a medical condition that made it dangerous for him to stay and wait for the tide the come back in, and took him to Hilton Head Hospital. (U.S. Coast Guard video)

 

The 37-year-old man’s brother, who was kayaking with him, called for help about 4 p.m., reporting they were stranded and his brother had a medical condition which put him at risk if he waited there for the tide to come back in.
